verdict.rationale: Portkey documents a REST inference API at `https://api.portkey.ai/v1`, where gateway features are applied by changing the base URL and adding Portkey-specific headers. However, the evidence presents logs, the model catalog and budget administration mainly as UI surfaces (a 'single pane', a Logs section, copying a log URL from the address bar), and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404, so UI-to-API parity is not shown. Missing for 10: evidence of management/admin APIs for logs, configs, model catalog, budgets and rate limits; a published OpenAPI spec; any explicit statement or independent confirmation that everything doable in the UI is doable via the API.
